rules.name: HMS Agamemnon (Rule 1)
rules.description: Once per activation, HMS Agamemnon can sail an extra inch.

rules.name: HMS Agamemnon (Rule 2)
rules.description: Agamemnon starts any game with 6 Ship Points fewer than its maximum total, which can be repaired during a game.

rules.name: HMS Bellerophon
rules.description:
For every successful hit scored against her, roll a D6. On a result of 5 or 6, Bellerophon takes no
damage from that hit.

rules.name: HMS Colossus
rules.description: Colossus does not suffer any penalties for shooting her third- and fourth-gun positions

rules.name: HMS Naiad (Rule 1)
rules.description: A ship that rolls to Strike the Colours due to direct action of the Naiad will have to re-roll if the first roll was successful. The player must accept the second result.

rules.name: HMS Naiad (Rule 2)
rules.description: Once per game, a player may declare a repair action on the Naiad and still shoot and move as normal.

rules.name: HMS Victory
rules.description: HMS Victory and all ships within 20", gain a +1 to the dice roll of all Skill Tests.

rules.name: Drilled
rules.description: British ships receive a +1 to hit modifier when shooting.

rules.name: The Admiralty
rules.description: Each British ship can re-roll one failed Skill Test per game. You must accept the re-rolled result.

rules.name: Tacking Proficiency
rules.description: All Royal Navy ships receive a +1 when rolling a Skill Test for tacking.

rules.name: HMS Indefatigable
rules.description: If a ship takes damage from HMS Indefatigable and is below half its original Ship Points, it must immediately take a Strike the Colours test with a -1 modifier.

rules.name: Admiral Lord Edward Pellew (Rule 1)
rules.description: Re-roll one Skill Test per Turn, you must accept the second result.

rules.name: Admiral Lord Edward Pellew (Rule 2)
rules.description: The ship will never Strike the Colours no matter the circumstances.

rules.name: Admiral Lord Horatio Nelson (Rule 1)
rules.description: Every British ship within 20" of Nelson’s ship, including his own, gains a +1 to the dice roll of every Skill Test.

rules.name: Admiral Lord Horatio Nelson (Rule 2)
rules.description: The ship will never Strike the Colours no matter the circumstances.

rules.name: Admiral Lord Horatio Nelson (Rule 3)
rules.description: Once per Turn, each gun position on the ship Nelson is commanding can re-roll one dice that fails its to hit roll.

rules.name: Admiral Lord Horatio Nelson (Rule 4)
rules.description: If the ship Nelson is commanding takes damage from musket fire from a ship with the Sharpshooters upgrade (see page 35 and 75), roll a D6. On a result of 1 or 2, Nelson dies; his special rules have no further affect on the game.

rules.name: Admiral Cuthbert Collingwood
rules.description: Every British ship within 10" of Collingwood, including his own, can re-roll the first broadside it shoots. All dice are re-rolled and the second result must be accepted

rules.name: Thomas Cochrane (Rule 1)
rules.description: A ship that has Cochrane on board starts the battle with a different flag to the rest of the fleet. It cannot be targeted until aftyer it opens fire on an enemy ship.

rules.name: Thomas Cochrane (Rule 2)
rules.description: A ship commanded by Cochrane gets an extra +1C when firing broadside at any ship one rate higher. It gets an extra +1C and +1H when firing on a ship two rates or more higher.

rules.name: Thomas Cochrane (Rule 3)
rules.description: Cochrane favoured a direct approach. Whenever possible and only if the enemy is more than 8" away from his ship, Cochrane must steer his ship towards an enemy vessel.

rules.name: Captain Richard Hall Gower (Rule 1)
rules.description: Captain Gower can only be used on merchant ships.

rules.name: Captain Richard Hall Gower (Rule 2)
rules.description: The ship gains a Veteran crew at no cost.

rules.name: Captain Richard Hall Gower (Rule 3)
rules.description: Once per activation, a ship with Gower on board can sail an extra inch.

rules.name: Captain George Duff
rules.description: +1 to all Skill Tests.
